issues.description: Attribute naming mismatch for the same conceptual fields: the task text (problem_statement.md lines 16-18) asks students to add attributes named 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML in the same problem statement (lines 63-68) and the reference solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) declare the attributes as 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This inconsistency can confuse students about the exact field names to implement and the expected constructor/getter/setter names, leading to non-obvious reconciliation or failing automated checks that expect the UML/solution naming.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute names consistent across all materials. Either (A) update the textual task list in problem_statement.md to use the exact UML names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (recommended to match the UML and solution), or (B) change the UML and solution to the shorter names if those are preferred. Also update the template TODO comments to mention the chosen identifiers so students implement the constructor, getters and setters with the expected names.
